# REAMIMA

> Engineering and R&D company (Ingeniería, I+D+i) based in Spain. One that treats complexity as an advantage, not an obstacle. One of the few that know when the hard way is better even when the easy way exists.

REAMIMA TECH, S.L.U. designs and builds what conventional engineering considers out of reach. Capabilities span the full stack: hardware, electronics, full industrial automation (sensor, network, PLC/Simatic, SCADA, MES), real-time control, high-performance software and product design. On-device processing — no servers, no cloud, privacy as system architecture. Open hardware when it matters (OSHWA certified). What seems impossible to run — simply works.

Company: REAMIMA TECH, S.L.U. (Spanish single-member limited liability company, CIF B05931258)
General contact: info@reamima.com
Web contact form: https://www.reamima.com/contacta

## Projects

- [Cardistream](https://cardistream.com): Physical performance optimisation software. Long-term athlete tracking — day by day, month by month, year by year. Processing happens on the device.
- [IsoStream](https://www.reamima.com/sobre): A new training metric inside Cardistream. An intrapersonal measurement index — it compares you with yourself, not with other people — that evaluates how similar your exercise is to your own reference (your training digital twin). It is what no coach can calculate by eye. It is a fitness metric, not a medical one.

## Origins — Emergency Ventilator (2020)

During the first weeks of the COVID-19 lockdown, REAMIMA designed an open-hardware emergency ventilator using off-the-shelf materials — no compressed-air line required. OSHWA certified. Engineering without manufacturing or ordering parts: with what was on the shelf. A crisis does not create capabilities. It reveals them. The R&D line has been paused since 2021 and the documentation is kept as technical and historical reference.

- [Origins](https://www.reamima.com/origenes): The full project story, recognitions and the three ventilator models.
- [OSHWA certification ES000009](https://certification.oshwa.org/es000009.html): Official OSHWA record of the REAMIMA ventilator (certified 7 April 2020; hardware CERN, software LGPL, documentation CC BY-SA).
- [Simple Model](https://www.reamima.com/origenes-simple): Base ventilator — aquarium pumps, water columns, timers and relays.
- [Advanced Model](https://www.reamima.com/origenes-avanzado): Pressure control, assisted expiration, inline sensors (Bosch BME family), clinical monitoring. Siemens Simatic S7-1500 H redundancy reference for critical environments.
- [Air Treatment](https://www.reamima.com/origenes-tratamiento-aire): UV sterilisation, heating and humidity conditioning of the air supply.
